name: Ingredient Convert MCP
description: Cooking ingredient unit converter (cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, ml, grams, ounces) using a measured density table plus recipe scaling. Tools: convert_ingredient, list_ingredients, scale_recipe, convert_bulk, decimal_to_fraction, fraction_to_decimal, common_conversions. Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint, no account or API key.
